capabilities.description: Monitors ice temperature readings and puts upcoming public sessions on hold when the ice stays too warm; held sessions can be cancelled with every paid ticket refunded (including retrying failed refunds), or released back on sale.
capabilities.name: Ice condition monitoring and session safety holds

capabilities.description: Lets clubs book half or full ice at a club rate and invoices them monthly for the ice time they used.
capabilities.name: Club ice rental and monthly invoicing

capabilities.description: Managers create skating sessions. The public can list sessions and see how many places are left, based on capacity reduced by club bookings and on tickets and hire skates already held.
capabilities.name: Session scheduling and availability

capabilities.description: Sells session tickets with pricing and membership allowances. Payment-provider results are settled idempotently, and unpaid bookings are released once their 15-minute payment window runs out.
capabilities.name: Ticket sales and payment settlement

capabilities.description: Produces figures for each session over a week or a chosen date range.
capabilities.name: Session performance reporting

capabilities.description: Sorts business failures into categories and explains each one in plain language to callers when a rink rule is broken.
capabilities.name: Business rule violation reporting
